scope: P03/P06/T02 existing-owner availability maintenance across native PD and the TiDB adapter; no complete Go package acceptance

source_inventory.scope: Inventory only; no whole-package acceptance. Includes the service-discovery production and original support/test obligations.

repairs: Shared network availability skips non-serving members, with leader fallback when no member is eligible.
REGION_NOT_FOUND starts a ten-second follower cooldown shared by all region APIs; unrelated RPC/header errors and missing payload retain distinct retry policy.
Unchanged topology retains rotation/health/cooldown; replaced API/member identities isolate late request and health observations. Network recovery never clears API suppression.
Cooldown expiry checks the current API ring after health I/O, including membership replacement while a probe is pending.
Both existing process runtimes independently poll health and TSO discovery, share cached channels, and cancel/join health work during close.
Health probes use Go one-second cadence, configured leader timeout and one-third-second follower budget across dialing, readiness and RPC.
PD and TiKV now share the health wire exchange while keeping their distinct status policies; adapter request construction no longer fabricates a target without feedback identity.

before.diagnostics: Initial fixture compilation required correcting a Rust Result alias and native/workspace tonic body/codec differences. One adapter command used the repository root instead of rust/ and failed before execution. These are not behavioral baseline failures. The native readable log also retains the initial diagnostic from overlapping log writers; its two test assertion failures and summary are explicit. The corrected adapter run selected zero txnkv tests; no coverage is claimed for that zero-match control.

native.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo --config /workspace/.cloud-setup/native-cargo.toml test --locked -p tikv-client --lib -- pd:: region_cache::test:: --test-threads=1

adapter.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo test --locked -p tidb-pd-client -p tidb-txnkv --lib --test all --no-fail-fast -- pd_client_source:: pd_region_loader_source:: client::worker_lifecycle_tests:: --test-threads=1

tidb_all_targets.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 cargo check --locked -p tidb-pd-client -p tidb-txnkv -p tidb-server --all-targets

gates.actual_precommit: Required executable hooks/pre-commit selected by core.hooksPath=hooks; final source commit must pass cd rust && cargo build --locked -p tidb-server. Exact completion is recorded outside the self-referential source commit in final-handoff.json.
gates.immediate_prepush: The same locked server build immediately precedes every native and TiDB push; no hooks or force-push bypass.

self_review: Typed region errors retain identity before projection; generic failures do not start cooldown.
No locks are held across health I/O and no probe is detached.
Publication preserves unchanged members; old handles cannot mutate replacement state.
Review found current-ring expiry after a stalled probe; corrected in the native follow-up and covered by the existing paused-clock concurrency case.
Native/workspace tonic version compatibility is maintained in patch030, not by editing the vendor copy.

No Go files/imports, Bazel metadata or module dependencies changed; bazel_prepare is not required. The obsolete Ready skill path is absent; current AGENTS.md and docs/agents/testing-flow.md supply the applicable gates.
limits: Full Go test suites and complete PD/service-discovery/TSO/grpcutil package acceptance were not run or granted.
Forwarding, TSO proxy, router transport, remaining discovery/security/platform obligations and TiKV RequestSelector/cache consolidation remain open.
Live multi-node TiKV, TLS topology changes and workload performance were not validated.
Unrelated historical parser/table_diff/session/DDL failures retain their existing receipts; this batch neither deletes them nor calls them green.
Cloud draft saving, publication and fresh-task restoration are distinct; restoration remains unverified.

publication.tidb: Final source commit/push pending at receipt creation; final-handoff.json records actual gates and remote identity.
